cues.text: The Velvet Room. The four Persona cards you chose lie face up on the table before Igor; Elizabeth stands beside his chair.
Igor passes a gloved hand over the cards and each one flares. He raises them upright, grinning behind them, then flicks them up into the air above his chair. They hang in a square and pulse.
Streams of energy burst from the cards and rush at you as you sit in your chair; they pierce your head and scatter into glittering shards.
The new Persona takes shape before you, then shrinks back into a single card.
